$comment: Vendored/adopted skill pools fed to OMP by omp/extensions/dotfiles-skills.ts (resources_discover skillPaths). Marketplace-installed pools do NOT belong here - installers/omp.sh installs them into omp's own plugin tree with omp plugin install (omp does not read Claude Code's plugin registry). Fields: root = package root relative to the dotfiles dir (skills expected at <root>/skills); ompSkillsDir = a skills directory to use instead of <root>/skills; omp=false = skip the pool. installers/omp.sh clones the vendor/ checkouts.

sources.$comment: One agent-c skill, linked per-skill by installers/omp.sh into this farm; pointing at agent-c's whole skills directory would publish ~100 skills.

installers/omp.sh clones the whole pulumi/agent-skills repo, but only three of its four plugin groups are fed to omp here. package-maintenance targets Pulumi provider-repo maintainers: its upstream-patches skill operates on a provider's upstream/ git submodule via scripts/upstream.sh, which no ~/src checkout has.
